kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انحلبت (form VII)
# اِنْحَلَبْتُ (inḥalabtu) /in.ħa.lab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْحَلَبَ (inḥalaba)
# اِنْحَلَبْتَ (inḥalabta) /in.ħa.lab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْحَلَبَ (inḥalaba)
# اِنْحَلَبْتِ (inḥalabti) /in.ħa.lab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْحَلَبَ (inḥalaba)
# اِنْحَلَبَتْ (inḥalabat) /in.ħa.la.bat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
